verses.en: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],
when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,
verses.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا

verses.en: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
